name: Colosseum Near-RT RIC
description: Minimal near-RT RIC (O-RAN SC Bronze release) adapted for the Colosseum wireless network emulator with support for concurrent base station and xApp connections.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Scripts will start a minimal near-real-time RIC in the form of Docker containers (namely, db, e2mgr, e2rtmansim, e2term). Commands: docker logs e2term -f, docker exec -it sample-xapp-24 bash.

eval_notes: Lightweight RIC for emulation environments. Good for xApp development and E2 interface testing in containerized setups. Foundation of ColO-RAN / OpenRAN Gym research. 4 Docker containers for a minimal RIC. Good for testing xApp deployment and E2 message handling in emulated wireless environments.
